entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2079073928612821760: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 214.5745 +/- 0.0476 mas (same row, RUWE 1.61): 4.66 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 349.363, -480.322 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.14 solar radii from Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: radius 0.14 solar radii (theoretical radius) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.5552). Mass 0.12 solar masses from Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: mass 0.12 solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.5552). Temperature 2865 K from TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 274127413: Teff.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 2,865 K, because the Washington Double Star catalogue (Mason et al. 2001, AJ 122, 3466; VizieR B/wds/wds) lists WDS 19539+4425 GIC 159 AB: 6 arcsec apart, magnitudes 14.26 and 14.96: the companion gives 34.4% of the light, which a measured spectrum would blend with the star's. The color is the Planck spectrum at the star's temperature, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffb364. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 2,865 K and log g 5.22 (u1 0.228, u2 0.546): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Spin
entries.finding: Inclination 40 degrees from the line of sight, period 0.71 d, from Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: rotation period 0.71 d and an axis 40 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with; the axis's direction on the sky is a convention.
